name: Crescent Blade Master (Combat)
body:
You have perfected the use of crescent blades, gaining a deadly control to which few have ever aspired.

Prerequisites: Dex 13, Int 13, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (crescent blade).

Benefit: You do not take a penalty on attack rolls when wielding a crescent blade. Additionally, you treat crescent blades as if they had the disarm and trip qualities. (See page 20 for details on crescent blades.)

Normal: Crescent blades impose a –2 penalty on attack rolls.
